about:
B&G Manufacturing operates from Hatfield, Pennsylvania, where it has been a family-owned and -managed business for over six decades. The company traces its roots to a founding commitment to manufacturing excellence, though the exact year is not publicly stated. Today, the firm remains under family leadership, emphasizing expertise, integrity, and reliability as core values.

The company produces custom fasteners and precision components through a vertically integrated operation that spans turning, Swiss-style turning, milling (including dedicated PEEK), deep-hole gun drilling, forging, bolt bending, shearing, thread rolling, thread cutting, grinding, wire and sink EDM, heat treating, titanium anodizing, laser marking, ultrasonic cleaning, shot peening, glass beading, passivation, and metallurgical evaluation. Its Hatfield facility houses more than 10,000 standard part numbers in stock for next-day shipment, while also running custom prototypes and large-scale production runs tracked via SAP ERP and MII systems.

B&G serves four primary sectors: medical (spinal implants, surgical instrumentation, bone-fracture and trauma devices), energy (nuclear, hydroelectric, natural-gas, and coal power generation), oil and gas (exploration, extraction, refining, and transport in harsh environments), and aerospace and defense (fasteners for ships, aircraft, and submarines). Customers include OEMs, military agencies, and nuclear power operators requiring compliance with ASME Section III, 10 CFR 50, and FDA 21 CFR 820.

The firm differentiates itself through full vertical integration, which shortens lead times and tightens supply-chain control; a 90-percent on-time delivery record; real-time quality tracking via SAP; and a family culture that prioritizes long-term customer relationships over transactional sales.
